summary: All prior blocking findings are fixed and tested, but the lock subsystem crashes with an unhandled OverflowError on an out-of-range owner_pid, install.sh still re-renders the committed dist/ with personal FACTORY_HOME models, ledger-add still tracebacks on malformed timestamps, and three smaller residuals remain.

findings.summary: An out-of-range owner_pid crashes _alive with OverflowError, so every writer and even `lock take --force` die with a traceback.
findings.evidence: Demonstrated with owner_pid 2**70: acquire, take and take(force=True) raise OverflowError at os.kill (lock.py:52); take evaluates _live before force (lock.py:172). ENG-17, ENG-24.
findings.fix: Catch OverflowError/ValueError/TypeError in _alive and treat as live; evaluate `not force` before _live in take; add a regression test; re-render dist.

findings.summary: install.sh re-renders the committed dist/ and render.py merges ${FACTORY_HOME}/config.json models whenever FACTORY_HOME is exported, writing personal model ids into dist/.
findings.evidence: Demonstrated in a sandbox: personal model written into dist/opencode/agents. install.sh:44 and :55 invoke render.py with the caller's environment. Constitution III; CI drift gate.
findings.fix: Unset FACTORY_HOME for the render invocations or render to a temp dist; keep the --models report reading the user's home without writing dist/.

findings.summary: ledger-add with a malformed timestamp still dies with TypeError instead of exit 5 (round-1 STD-2 unfixed).
findings.fix: Parse both flags with state.parse_iso in cli.py and die_usage on None; add a test.

findings.summary: lock.release unlinks by path after an ownership read with no identity re-check.
findings.evidence: release (lock.py:156-165); the other unlink paths carry a swap guard. ENG-23.

findings.summary: checkpoint writes state before committing; a failing git commit leaves the stage advanced and a retry appends a duplicate history entry.
findings.evidence: write_run at 548 precedes commit_worktree (551-561). ENG-24, ENG-26.
findings.fix: Report state-committed-but-commit-failed or roll back the history entry; add a failing-commit test.

findings.summary: Stale duplicate copies of both LockCliTests methods remain after unittest.main().
